verdict.reason: Rey Cortiço is worth a quick check for lunch — 13:00, but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  Wind is the main thing to watch.  The tide should let the sandbars work without overdoing it.

conversationalSummary.text: For TODAY, I’d treat Rey Cortiço (around lunch/13:00) as a check-first option—there’s just about enough size, and the tide should be pushing, but the wind setup isn’t great for this spot. Before you leave, do a quick look on the Surfline cams and the MEO Beachcam and cancel the plan if it doesn’t look clean and organised. If the cams look surprisingly better than expected, then go for it; otherwise, it’s probably not worth chasing.
